description: Sign the user in to Hushdrop (free account) without leaving the agent. Returns verify_url: show it to the user to open and approve, then call finish_login. A free account keeps drops at hushdrop.dev/<handle>/... instead of expiring in 24h, with version history, rollback and per-drop editors; teams are on the Team plan.

provider.description: Sign in with a Google or Microsoft work account, or 'sso' for the company's SAML sign-in (joins the company's team). Omit for GitHub or email link.

name: login
title: Sign in to Hushdrop
